title: Reconstruction of u from invertible finite reductions
statement: For the finite coefficient extension and coherent dualizing data of [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core], if every normalized finite reduction of u is invertible, then u is invertible.

proof.text: Apply integralConstructibleReductionHom to the inverse family of the finite reductions. Naturality of u and inversion of the transition square give successor compatibility. Lift the family and its inverse; uniqueness applied to the identity families proves both composites are identities.
